caseName: Eli Lilly & Co. v. Medtronic, Inc.
caseNameFull: Eli Lilly & Co. v. Medtronic, Inc.

opinions.text:
C. A. Fed. Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 889.] Application for recall and stay of mandate of the United States Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit, addressed to The Chief Justice and referred to the Court, denied.

Justice O’Connor took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
